summary: Embassy Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a $0.55 per share annual cash dividend declared by the board, a ~14% increase over the prior year. The dividend is payable July 14, 2026 to holders of record June 26, 2026. The press release also touts the bank's 17th consecutive dividend, its 5-Star Bauer rating, and local market rankings. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return (beyond routine dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
